subject: Expo crate: tariff reclassification and split-manifest hold at SFO - action required
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@blueanchor.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Juan Ramos <juan@apexfreight.com>
Cc: mcshipping@moscone.org
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hold at SFO - crate shipment (MAWB 34781) flagged for tariff mismatch

Hi Grace,

Quick heads-up: ocean container MAWB 34781 (arrived yesterday at SFO) is being held by customs because the HS/ tariff description on the submitted manifest doesn't match the commercial invoice. The carrier flagged three pieces (exhibit crate A3-A5) as "household furniture" which is triggering different duty treatment and a secondary inspection request.

I've attached the provisional manifest and the commercial invoice we received from the shipper. We can file a correction with CBP to reclassify those lines as "exhibit/display hardware & electronics (temporary import)" but the broker will need a corrected invoice or a formal letter from you stating the shipment is for temporary exhibition (temporary admission). If eligible, a carnet or temporary import paperwork will avoid duties.

Options and immediate asks from our side:
- If you can provide a short letter on company letterhead confirming these are exhibition materials and will be re-exported after the show, we can attach that to the correction.
- Juan (Apex) can submit an urgent manifest amendment and broker the release; estimated expedite fees below.
- If we proceed, expect a customs hold release target of 24-72 hours from submission (subject to inspection).

Estimated fees: broker expedite $650, customs supervision/inspection (if selected) $300-900.

What I need from you now:
1) Confirmation to proceed with amendment and approval of the expedite fee.
2) A one-paragraph letter on Redwood letterhead stating event name, exhibit dates (Jun 4-7), and that crates are temporary exhibition materials.

Sorry for the noise — we are pushing this as high priority.

Best,
Sara Patel
BlueAnchor Logistics
(415) 555-0194

Tessa (field ops) — FYI as this impacts load-in planning. Stephanie — can you provide a one-paragraph letter on Redwood letterhead (copy below) and confirm whether we should pursue an ATA carnet vs temporary admission? Event date is Jun 4-7 at Moscone Center; delivery must arrive at venue no later than Jun 2 for crate build.

Suggested letter copy (please edit as needed):
"Redwood Inference confirms that the shipment MAWB 34781 contains exhibit materials for the Redwood Inference booth at the Moscone Center (Jun 4-7, 2026). The materials are temporary imports and will be re-exported following the event."

Juan — can you confirm: 1) the current HS/tariff number on the manifest; 2) the exact amendment code you will submit; and 3) estimated time-to-release if we push now? Also include any invoice or power-of-attorney you need from us.

Please keep this tight — we don't want to miss the venue cutoff.

> Juan — can you confirm: 1) the current HS/tariff number on the manifest; 2) the exact amendment code you will submit; and 3) estimated time-to-release if we push now?

Grace — current paperwork lists the line items under HTS 9403.60 (household furniture). Based on the description and photos, these crates are display modules and electronics — they should be classified under HTS 9403.90 (other furniture/fixtures for displays) with temporary admission annotation. I will submit a Manifest Amendment (code: MAA) and a corrected commercial description.

I need either: (A) the company letter Grace drafted on letterhead, or (B) a signed commercial invoice with revised descriptions. If you authorize, I will proceed immediately.

Estimated timeline if we submit the amendment now:
- Manifest amendment filed within 2 hours
- Customs review and release target: 12-48 hours (if no physical inspection)
- If selected for exam, add 24-72 hours depending on port workload

Fees: $650 expedite filing + $125 carrier admin + potential inspection fees. Total estimate: $775 - $1,100.

I'll also request an internal re-route to the bonded warehouse in Oakland to keep the crates secure until release; that will add a short transfer.

I'll proceed once I receive the Redwood letter or corrected invoice.

Regards,
